title: Ashton Jeanty: Expectation is for me to lead, so I have to make a big jump

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ashton Jeanty: Expectation is for me to lead, so I have to make a big jump
sources.description: Ashton Jeanty came into the NFL with high expectations for what he'd do in the Raiders' backfield, but the 2025 first-round pick's rookie season did not meet them.
